blurb: Guests climb on 15 ft tall bouldering walls with thick pads below for safety. The facility offers drop-in climbing, memberships, clinics for kids, group bookings, and crash pad rentals. Programs include skill-building activities and supervised sessions for various ages.
extraNote: Annual membership cannot be frozen, cancelled, or refunded · EFT membership cancellation fee applies if cancelled within 12 months · Crash pad rentals require gear rental waiver and credit card for damages · Crash pads must be returned by 9:00pm on return date; $15/day late fee · Kids clinic cancellations accepted until 48hrs before first session with full refund · Front entrance on the North side of the building
